name: Narukami Karen
source: A new member chosen by Ark to replace Machina. Karen is normally a reserved and humble person, but if it is for her friends and people she trust, she would become a selfless person that could sacrifice herself. Until the moment, she lived her life peacefully in the Academy. Her bust and ass are well developed.
